g.title: n1
g.text: • hadith_id is a NATURAL key (Ifta mainId), not generated.
• hadith_num is text: some books use compound numbers.
• chapter_id is NULLABLE — a hadith need not sit under a chapter.
• matn_plain NULL = sanad/matn split not available for that row.
• collections.slug is UNIQUE — the stable external identifier.
• hadith_subjects was REMOVED: no feature, query or ETL
• hadith_translations is a WEAK entity on hadiths, PK
(hadith_id, lang) — one canonical text per language.
Source-tagged, so LK is one feeder among several;
a missing row falls back to Arabic.
